final.role: Keyword retriever using BM25 over an in-memory document store (Haystack component)
final.evidence: InMemoryBM25Retriever is a keyword-based Retriever that fetches Documents matching a query from a temporary in-memory database ... based on the BM25 algorithm.

conferencia.nota: Componente BM25 em memoria do Haystack; util como referencia de busca lexical, mas e biblioteca Python, nao MCP.
